product_metadata.title: Microwave Pasta Cooker with Strainer and Lid, Food Grade 3 Tier Microwavable Pasta Boat Vegetable Steamer Spaghetti Noodle Cooker for Dorm Small Kitchen Office, No Mess Sticking or Waiting for Boil
features: NO MORE WAITING FOR WATER TO BOIL - With our pasta cooker for microwave oven you can get your pasta done faster without having to wait for the water to boil. No need for large pots and heating up the kitchen. Best of all, no scalding when pouring out the water and trying not to miss the colander with the pasta!

EFFORTLESS USAGE - Place your desired quantity of pasta in the pasta cooker microwaveable, add water, and heat it in the microwave until it is ready. Drain the excess water, and voila, all done! It is that simple!

FOOD GRADE MATERIAL AND HEAT RESISTANT - This microwave pasta cooker with strainer lid is made of food grade PP material. You don’t have to worry about the chemicals might seep into your food anymore. It’s durable and not easily detach whilst also heat-resistant; making it perfectly safe to be put in microwave.

PERFECT FOR VEGETABLES AND NOODLES - Not only pasta and noodles, this versatile pasta pot microwave works great to steam some vegetables and it does the job wonderfully. This pasta microwave cooker is so handy, quick and easy to clean up! No boiling water then stirring constantly so no sticking.

AL DENTE PASTA ANYTIME - Another simple tips for perfect pasta, salt your pasta cooking water a little bit to add taste and create a good texture. Excellent to use for frozen ravioli, tortellini, spaghetti, and noodles. Try some recipe in our eBook given when you purchase this pasta maker microwave.
